    Victor Wembanyama (SAS): 23 points, active as a passer,. 
    Stephon Castle (SAS): 22 points, high-impact performance. 
    Devin Vassell (SAS): 16 points. 
    Gary Trent Jr. (MIL): 18 points (leading scorer for Bucks). 
    Ryan Rollins (MIL): 12 points, 5 turnovers. 
    Key Team Stats (March 28, 2026): 
    • Spurs: 55% FG, 40% 3PT, 38 points in the paint.
    • Bucks: 44% FG, 30% 3PT, 30 points in the paint.
